## Description

Context: what we decided and why. Subscriptions will have seats, but plans are built in P5. Until then every organisation gets one hard-coded starter plan so growth is bounded and the upgrade conversation exists: 1 doctor plus 2 other staff (any mix of nurse, receptionist, admin; the owner-doctor is the doctor), counted per organisation in total across all its locations (MDV-P1-070); a bigger chain needs a bigger plan (MDV-P5-042). Patients are not capped. Self-service upgrade comes with MDV-P5-042 and MDV-P5-016; the owner is responsible for what they choose then.
What to build. One place (a small plan class with a shortcut: comment, hard-coded plan, replaced by entitlements when MDV-P5-042 lands) counts active and invited doctors and other staff per organisation (tenant), in total across its locations, never per location. Adding a doctor, adding staff and sending an invitation are refused server-side beyond the cap with the message "Your plan allows 1 doctor and 2 staff; contact Medvya to upgrade". The web shows the same message. Offboarded members and revoked invitations free their seat. A race of parallel invitations cannot exceed the cap.
Touched: Medvya.Tenancy.Infrastructure/Doctors.cs, Invitations.cs, Medvya.Identity.Api/StaffEndpoints.cs, Medvya.Tenancy.Api settings endpoints, web/clinic staff and doctors features, i18n en, hi, ar.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a clinic with its owner-doctor and 2 other staff, when the owner adds a third staff member or invites one, then the server refuses with "Your plan allows 1 doctor and 2 staff; contact Medvya to upgrade".
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a clinic with 1 doctor, when the owner adds a second doctor, then it is refused with the same message.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a staff member is offboarded or an invitation is revoked, when the owner adds another, then it is allowed.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an organisation with several locations, when staff are added at different locations, then they count together against the one cap.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given any number of patients, when patients are registered, then no cap applies.
- [ ] **AC6.** Given parallel add or invite calls, when they race, then the cap still holds (integration test).

## Test notes

- Unit: cap counting by role.
- Integration on real PostgreSQL: cap, seat release, 100 parallel invitations.
- Playwright: Settings, Staff shows the message in English and Arabic.
- Security: server-side only; ponytail-review; cap cannot be bypassed by another endpoint.
- Browser: English and Arabic, axe clean.
